scope: Retriever item/metadata matching and capability relay input ownership, plus three outdated transfer fixtures. No pipeline registry/storage change.

runtime_fixes.change: Retriever without template accepts both modes; installed template compares item and damage metadata (32767 template wildcard), ignores extra NBT. Ordinary item-filter empty whitelist and logistics NBT matching are unchanged.

Insert a copy into the receiver so a Vanilla InvWrapper storing a complete stack cannot alias and later mutate the caller offer. Preserve live target lookup, simulation semantics, invalidation and cycle guards.
runtime_fixes.observation: Original portal fixture inserted 3 and extracted 2; an aliased caller offer could become 1 before the closed-portal rejection check. Added a caller count==3 assertion before closure.

fixture_corrections.change: Use registered long_dist_pipe_item instead of the legacy field now aliasing the fluid pipe. Preserve simulation, NBT, insertion and cached disconnect checks.
Use the adopted six-direction SourceExtenderBlock main/secondary properties; explicitly route north input to south inventory. Keep removal/replacement checks.
Assert legacy field identity equals source fluid pipe; fluid line works, item route refuses all without consuming the offer. Do not make the original fluid pipe carry both types.
